input: s1 and s2 are strings containing lowercase ASCII characters a through z only. Each character is one UTF-16 code unit. Unicode normalization, surrogate handling, uppercase letters and other characters are outside the domain. An empty s1 returns true, including when s2 is empty. A nonempty s1 longer than s2 returns false. Both string lengths are safe integers supported by the runtime, at most 9007199254740991. Window counts, deficits and indices stay within those safe-integer bounds. Inputs are not validated.
return: Type: boolean. Exact boolean equality for whether some length-s1.length contiguous window of s2 has the same character multiplicities as s1. Invariants: counts stores pattern counts minus current window counts for 26 characters; missing is the sum of positive deficits. For an incoming character, decrease missing only if its count was positive before decrementing that count. For an outgoing character, increment its count first and then increase missing if that count is positive. Test missing only after the window has been reduced to at most window_size. For a nonempty pattern, missing cannot be zero before a complete window exists.
mutation_aliasing: Input mutation: none. scalar result No persistent Solution instance state.
numeric: Exact safe-integer Number indices and count updates within the stated length bounds; no bitwise coercions. Both string lengths are safe integers supported by the JavaScript runtime, at most 9007199254740991. Only lowercase ASCII a through z is supported.
complexity: m = s1.length; n = s2.length O(m + n) worst case; each input character is processed at most a constant number of times. O(26), or O(1) for the fixed lowercase ASCII alphabet; no substring copies or per-window sorting.
source_accounting: The Solution class, method, fixed-size count Array, charCodeAt conversions, window updates and empty-pattern branch are all charged as source. No external helper library or hidden source expansion.
